app.name: S.H.I.E.L.D.
app.subtitle: TESSERACT STEM HERO
app.tagline: A Journey Where Knowledge Shapes the Future

science.name: Science
science.desc: Unlock the secrets of the natural universe.
science.longDesc: Journey through biology, chemistry, and physics to understand the fundamental laws that govern all matter and energy. Every discovery brings you closer to mastering the world around you.

sci-01.title: First Discovery
sci-01.desc: Observe natural forces and identify hidden patterns in matter.
sci-01.learningObjective: Analyze molecular arrangements to identify energy states.

sci-02.title: Scientific Variables
sci-02.desc: Manipulate Pressure, Catalyst ratio, and Heat to stabilize a compound.
sci-02.learningObjective: Understand variables, cause and effect, and controlled experimentation.

sci-03.title: Mystery Experiment
sci-03.desc: Investigate pH and wavelength combinations to heal a crystal compound.
sci-03.learningObjective: Observe results of mystery readings and form logical scientific conclusions.

sci-04.title: Science Challenge
sci-04.desc: Synthesize all observations to manage a space colony fusion overload.
sci-04.learningObjective: Integrate variables, pressure controls, and light resonance in one reactor.

technology.name: Technology
technology.desc: Build the tools that shape the future.
technology.longDesc: From logic gates to artificial intelligence, explore how technology amplifies human capability. Learn to code, design systems, and create digital solutions for real-world problems.

tech-01.title: Digital Spark
tech-01.desc: Understand basic binary logic and signal paths.
tech-01.learningObjective: Trace voltage flows across simple logic gates.

tech-02.title: Sequence Mission
tech-02.desc: Program command steps to guide a drone through a wider coordinate path.
tech-02.learningObjective: Understand sequence ordering and direction logic on coordinates.

tech-03.title: Debug the System
tech-03.desc: Diagnose and repair a faulty code sequence to avoid drone crashes.
tech-03.learningObjective: Identify bugs and construct corrections to solve broken operations.

tech-04.title: Code the Mission
tech-04.desc: Incorporate loops and repetition logic in a final navigation puzzle.
tech-04.learningObjective: Write structured code using repetition algorithms and loop cycles.

engineering.name: Engineering
engineering.desc: Design solutions that change the world.
engineering.longDesc: Engineering bridges imagination and reality. Learn to design, prototype, and build structures, machines, and systems — turning abstract ideas into tangible creations.

eng-01.title: Build Your Idea
eng-01.desc: Design basic trusses and load-bearing links.
eng-01.learningObjective: Identify load distributions on a cantilever model.

eng-02.title: Structure Challenge
eng-02.desc: Build a multi-span structural layout supporting heavy weight stress.
eng-02.learningObjective: Test material properties and torque equations on wider spans.

eng-03.title: Test and Improve
eng-03.desc: Iterate and reinforce a failing bridge configuration to prevent collapse.
eng-03.learningObjective: Analyze failures, isolate stress fractures, and modify structural anchors.

eng-04.title: Engineering Mission
eng-04.desc: Design a space gantry launch tower that resists extreme wind shear.
eng-04.learningObjective: Balance tension, loading support, and anchors within strict budgets.

mathematics.name: Mathematics
mathematics.desc: Master the language of patterns and logic.
mathematics.longDesc: Mathematics is the universal language written into the fabric of reality. From algebra to calculus to cryptography, develop the ability to see patterns, reason precisely, and solve the impossible.

math-01.title: Pattern Awakening
math-01.desc: Discover numerical sequences and fibonacci arcs.
math-01.learningObjective: Identify ratio limits in geometric sequence growth lines.

math-02.title: Pattern Explorer
math-02.desc: Solve Fibonacci progression equations and visual geometric grids.
math-02.learningObjective: Predict future indices in visual and golden ratio sequences.

math-03.title: Logic Challenge
math-03.desc: Solve balances of weights in a visual geometric scale equation.
math-03.learningObjective: Form algebraic variable equivalences to balance numeric scale ciphers.

math-04.title: Mathematical Portal
math-04.desc: Crack a dual-security cylinder lock combining arithmetic and geometric matrices.
math-04.learningObjective: Solve multi-layer ciphers combining sequence sums and rate changes.

stones.scienceStoneDesc: A crystallized shard of pure knowledge — forged from the light of a thousand discoveries. It pulses with the energy of the natural world.
stones.technologyStoneDesc: Woven from digital threads and silicon dreams, this stone hums with computational power. It is the heartbeat of the machine age.
stones.engineeringStoneDesc: Carved from the material of creation itself, the Forge Stone carries the weight of every bridge, engine, and structure ever built.
stones.mathematicsStoneDesc: Ancient as the cosmos, the Axiom Stone contains every truth that can be proven. Its geometry shifts and reforms in perfect symmetry.

dialogue.p3-04: Your future self. I have come from a time yet to unfold.
dialogue.p3-05: The world is heading toward a dangerous future.
dialogue.p3-06: You have been given a rare chance to change it.
dialogue.p3-08: Because I have already lived through everything you are about to face. There is not much time.
dialogue.p3-09: If you want to save the world, you must gain the knowledge you will need.
dialogue.p3-11: The four pillars of STEM. Science. Technology. Engineering. Mathematics.
dialogue.p3-12: Master all four, and you will have the power to face what is coming.
dialogue.p3-14: The Tesseract. The key to your entire journey.
dialogue.p3-15: Each learning path you complete will reward you with a special stone.
dialogue.p3-16: Four domains. Four paths. Four stones. You will need all of them.
dialogue.p3-17: Take it. It will guide you.
dialogue.p3-18: The journey will not be easy. But you are stronger than you know.
dialogue.p3-19: Trust the Tesseract. It will show you the way.
dialogue.p3-20: I will return... when you are ready.
dialogue.p4-01: So this is what the Tesseract was meant to do...
dialogue.p4-02: Then this is where my journey begins.
dialogue.sci-comp-01: You have mastered the Science path, Morales. You did not simply complete challenges; you learned how to think.
dialogue.sci-comp-02: Science has given you the power to understand what others cannot see. Observe, question, and discover.
dialogue.tech-comp-01: You have mastered the Technology path, Morales. You did not simply complete challenges; you learned how to think.
dialogue.tech-comp-02: Technology has given you the power to create. Think in systems, give instructions, and solve problems.
dialogue.eng-comp-01: You have mastered the Engineering path, Morales. You did not simply complete challenges; you learned how to think.
dialogue.eng-comp-02: Engineering has taught you how ideas become reality. Design, test, fail, and improve.
dialogue.math-comp-01: You have mastered the Mathematics path, Morales. You did not simply complete challenges; you learned how to think.
dialogue.math-comp-02: Mathematics has given you the power to see structure within complexity. Recognize patterns, reason, and find hidden relationships.
dialogue.hook-comp-01: Morales... you have gathered all four stones. You have completed the foundation.
dialogue.hook-comp-02: The Tesseract is fully aligned and beginning to awaken. But the final mission has not yet begun.
dialogue.hook-comp-03: Prepare yourself. The final gateway will open soon.
dialogue.m-intro-01: So this is the world my future self was talking about...
dialogue.m-intro-02: Four paths... four kinds of knowledge.
dialogue.hub-Moralestone-dialog-1: One path has been completed, Morales. Three remain. The Tesseract is beginning to awaken. Keep moving.
dialogue.hub-Moralestone-dialog-2: Two paths are active. The future timeline is beginning to bend. Your efforts are making a difference. Do not stop.
dialogue.hub-Moralestone-dialog-3: Three stones are united in the inventory. Only one pillar remains. The Tesseract energy is pulsing. The final test is near.
dialogue.hub-Moralestone-dialog-4: You have gathered what you were searching for. The foundations are complete. But the final mission has not yet begun.
dialogue.p1-01: You did it. You have completed all four STEM domains and collected all four stones.
dialogue.p1-02: I completed everything you asked me to. But what are these stones really for?
dialogue.p1-03: These stones represent more than your achievements.
dialogue.p1-04: Each one carries the knowledge and abilities you gained from Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics.
dialogue.p1-05: Then what do I have to do now?
dialogue.p1-07: Follow the path. At the end, you will find where the four stones belong.
dialogue.p2-02: You have become the person you were meant to become.
dialogue.p2-03: Your power was never in the suit.
dialogue.p2-04: The suit represents what you gained through your journey — knowledge, creativity, logic, problem-solving, and the courage to learn.
dialogue.p2-06: Yes. You are now ready to shape the future.
dialogue.p2-09: From now on, the future is in your hands.

finalConclusion.heroTransformation: KNOWLEDGE HAS BECOME YOUR POWER. STEM HERO
finalConclusion.chamberDesc: Place each stone into its designated altar to awaken the Tesseract.
finalConclusion.placeAllStones: PLACE ALL FOUR STONES TO AWAKEN THE TESSERACT

stageMap.completeMissionsPrompt: Complete each mission in order. Boss unlocks after all 9 missions!
stageMap.completeMissionsForBoss: Complete all missions to unlock the Stage Boss.
stageMap.sciDesc: Master observation, forces, energy, life science, and scientific method. Complete all 4 Stage Bosses to unlock the Science Stone!
stageMap.sciDesc1: Learn through observation, measurement, and experiments. Explore matter, light, sound, magnetism and forces.
stageMap.sciDesc2: Dive deeper into motion, force, energy, electricity, circuits, chemical changes, and density.
stageMap.sciDesc3: Explore cells, the human body, plants, food chains, ecosystems, the water cycle, and environmental science.
stageMap.sciDesc4: Master the scientific method, design experiments, analyze data, and solve complex integrated science challenges.
stageMap.techDesc: Master binary logic, programming, algorithms, web & cybersecurity. Complete all 4 Stage Bosses to unlock the Technology Stone!
stageMap.techDesc1: Learn computer basics, hardware vs software, binary counting, input/output devices, and file management.
stageMap.techDesc2: Master algorithms, flowcharts, pseudocode, block programming, variables, conditionals, and loops.
stageMap.techDesc3: Explore the internet, web pages, HTML/CSS basics, digital safety, cyber threats, and online privacy.
stageMap.techDesc4: Master software engineering, AI concepts, data structures, cloud computing, and real-world tech systems.
stageMap.engDesc: Master structural design, mechanics, electrical systems, and robotics. Complete all 4 Stage Bosses to unlock the Engineering Stone!
stageMap.engDesc1: Discover simple machines, levers, pulleys, gears, structural shapes, forces, and engineering design process.
stageMap.engDesc2: Design bridges, towers, mechanisms, electrical circuits, energy conversion, and material strength.
stageMap.engDesc3: Build complex systems, robotics, pneumatic/hydraulic power, automation, and environmental engineering.
stageMap.engDesc4: Master advanced structural engineering, aerodynamics, space launch systems, systems integration, and failure analysis.
stageMap.mathDesc: Master arithmetic, geometry, algebra, and mathematical ciphers. Complete all 4 Stage Bosses to unlock the Mathematics Stone!
stageMap.mathDesc1: Master number patterns, spatial geometry, basic equations, fractions, decimals, and measurement.
stageMap.mathDesc2: Explore algebra, ratios, proportions, coordinate geometry, statistics, and probability.
stageMap.mathDesc3: Master advanced algebra, trigonometry, geometric proofs, functions, exponents, and scale balance equations.
stageMap.mathDesc4: Master calculus concepts, matrices, cryptography, complex ciphers, and multi-variable logic matrices.
